rationale: Spe 66 and ACC 76 on a 10.1 kg quadruped favour quick, sly wide play; genus Devious and ability Prankster suit an unpredictable winger, and def 37 rules out defending.

name: Liepard
rationale: Spe 106 and a lean 37.5 kg quadruped frame make an elusive winger, and abilities Unburden and Prankster fit its trickery; the quadruped shape already trims TEC in Layer 1, so no change.

name: Pansage

name: Simisage
rationale: Balanced atk and spa 98 with spe 101 on a light 30.5 kg upright monkey frame already read as a creative forward; the Layer 1 bonus from kickMoves low-kick and low-sweep covers its footwork, so no change.

name: Pansear
rationale: Identical base stats to its grass and water siblings (spe 64, atk and spa 53) on an 11 kg upright monkey body; it projects as a small, quick attacker and warrants no adjustment.

name: Simisear
rationale: Spe 101 with atk and spa 98 on an upright 28 kg frame, plus kickMoves blaze-kick, already lifted SHO and KIC in Layer 1; that separates it from its siblings, so no further change.

name: Panpour
rationale: Genus Spray shares the monkey trio's spe 64 and atk 53 with a slightly heavier 13.5 kg build; upright shape gives usable feet and hands, but low base stats keep it a fringe wide attacker.

name: Simipour
rationale: Upright 29 kg frame with spe 101 and atk and spa 98 mirrors Simisage; it reads as a flair forward, and the baseline already ranks W, AM and ST correctly.

name: Munna
rationale: Spe 24 and atk 25 leave nothing for attacking, while hp 76 and ability Forewarn suit a sitting, anticipating role; the floating quadruped shape gives no kicking power, consistent with the baseline.

name: Musharna
rationale: Spe 29 with hp 116 and spa 107 make a stationary playmaker; the humanoid shape tag overstates its stubby limbs, so HAN, DRI and TEC ease, and genus Drowsing argues against any running role.

name: Pidove
rationale: Height 0.3 m and weight 2.1 kg with wings shape give flight but no physical game; base stats top out at atk 55, and Layer 1 wing mods already cover AER, so no change.

name: Tranquill
rationale: Wings shape at weight 15 kg with atk 77 and spe 65 suits a mid-sized aerial runner; Layer 1 wing mods already handle AER and ball skills, so no adjustment.

name: Unfezant
rationale: Atk 115 and spe 93 with wings shape give a powerful aerial forward; genus Proud carries no football signal and Layer 1 already rewarded flight, so the baseline stands.

name: Blitzle
rationale: Quadruped zebra at weight 29.8 kg with spe 76 and kickMoves double-kick favours raw running on the flank; def 32 and hp 45 make it fragile, which the baseline already shows.

name: Zebstrika
rationale: Spe 116 on a 79.5 kg quadruped makes an outright sprinter and kickMoves double-kick gives power; the quadruped shape already prices its hooves in Layer 1, so no change.

name: Roggenrola
rationale: Spe 15 and def 85 on a 0.4 m, 18 kg rock body make a slow, sturdy blocker; ability Sturdy fits a stay-at-home role, and the baseline already reflects it.

name: Boldore
rationale: Weight 102 kg with atk and def 105 and spe 20 make an immovable centre-back; the tentacles shape already cut ball skills in Layer 1, so no change.

name: Gigalith
rationale: Weight 260 kg with atk 135 and def 130 is the archetypal wall at centre-back; spe 25 rules out any wide role, and crystal limbs rather than hands justify trimming the tentacles-driven HAN.

name: Woobat
rationale: A 2.1 kg bat with spe 72 and wings shape is all flight and quickness with no strength; Layer 1 wing mods already lower TEC and lift AER, so no adjustment.

name: Swoobat
rationale: Spe 114 at weight 10.5 kg with wings makes a fast, flighty wide player; low atk 57 and def 55 keep it out of the middle, and the baseline already ranks W, WM and WB first.

name: Drilbur
rationale: A 0.3 m mole with atk 85 and spe 68 is a quick, burrowing nuisance up front; claw hands and short legs do not justify DRI 88, so it trims, and the tiny frame rules out aerial work.

name: Excadrill
rationale: Atk 135 and hp 110 on a compact 0.7 m, 40.4 kg body make a powerful drilling forward; height already sets its AER, so no change, and spa 50 keeps passing and vision modest.

name: Audino
rationale: Hp 103 with def and spd 86 and abilities Healer and Regenerator suit a tireless, supportive holding mid; spe 50 keeps it central, and the baseline already says so.

name: Timburr
rationale: Genus Muscular and abilities Guts and Iron Fist describe a small brawler with atk 80 but spe 35; Layer 1 already credited its long kickMoves list, so the baseline stands.

name: Gurdurr
rationale: Atk 105 and def 85 on a 40 kg upright frame with spe 40 make a combative centre-back or holding mid; the Muscular genus fits, and Layer 1's kick bonuses already lift SHO and TAK.

name: Conkeldurr
rationale: Atk 140 and weight 87 kg make a destroyer in duels, but it is designed leaning on two concrete pillars, so the move-driven TEC and KIC are trimmed.

name: Tympole
rationale: Fish shape at height 0.5 m has no legs, and Layer 1 already stripped its ball skills heavily; with spe 64 its only asset, it is a marginal wide option and needs no further cut.

name: Palpitoad
rationale: Hp 75 and spe 69 on a squat 17 kg toad body suit a tireless wide-to-central runner; stubby legs do not support DRI 70, so it trims slightly.

name: Seismitoad
rationale: Hp 105 with atk 95 and spa 85 on a stocky 62 kg humanoid body gives an all-round central presence; spe 74 is middling, so it belongs in the middle rather than wide, matching the baseline.

name: Throh
rationale: Genus Judo with hp 120 and atk 100 describes a grappler who wins body contests, so PHY rises a little; spe 45 keeps it in a deep defensive role.

name: Sawk
rationale: Genus Karate with atk 125, spe 85 and kickMoves double-kick and mega-kick makes a striking forward; Layer 1 move bonuses also inflated HAN and DIV, which a kicker does not earn, so both trim.

name: Sewaddle
rationale: Def 70 is its best stat on a 0.3 m, 2.5 kg caterpillar body with armor shape, so it plays as a small, cautious defender; nothing in the fields calls for a change.

name: Swadloon
rationale: Def 90 and spd 80 make a tough little blocker, but genus Leaf-Wrapped means a body bundled in leaves at height 0.5 m, so the arms-driven HAN boost is trimmed and it plays in front of goal rather than in it.

name: Leavanny
rationale: Spe 92 and atk 103 on a slim 20.5 kg humanoid with kickMoves triple-axel suit a nimble attacker, but its forelimbs are leaf blades, so the humanoid HAN bonus is cut hard.

name: Venipede

name: Scolipede
rationale: Spe 112 and weight 200.5 kg make a charging monster that wins races and collisions, but a long armor-shaped centipede has no diving body for goal, so DIV drops; spa 55 limits passing.

name: Cottonee

name: Whimsicott

name: Petilil
rationale: Blob shape at height 0.5 m with spe 30 gives no legs to speak of, and Layer 1 already cut its ball skills; ability Own Tempo and spa 70 suit a passive central role.

name: Lilligant

name: Basculin
rationale: Fish shape removes its legs and Layer 1 cut its ball skills to match, but atk 92, spe 98, kickMoves head-smash and genus Hostile leave a headstrong attacker who threatens mainly with its head.

name: Sandile
rationale: Atk 72 and spe 65 on a 15.2 kg quadruped with abilities Intimidate and Moxie make a snappy, aggressive runner; Layer 1 already gave the Intimidate TAK bonus, so no change.

name: Krokorok
rationale: Quadruped at weight 33.4 kg with atk 82 and spe 74, plus kickMoves low-kick and mega-kick, reads as a direct, aggressive forward; the baseline already ranks W and ST first.

name: Krookodile
rationale: Atk 117 and spe 92 on a 96.3 kg upright frame give a powerful, quick forward who can also defend; genus Intimidation and ability Intimidate fit its menace, already credited to TAK in Layer 1.

name: Darumaka
rationale: Atk 90 with ability Hustle gives an eager, heavy hitter, but a round 0.6 m daruma body with stubby limbs earns less than the humanoid tag gives, so DRI and HAN are trimmed.

name: Dwebble
rationale: Def 85 and a stone shell on a 0.3 m armor-shaped crab give a sturdy but tiny blocker; Layer 1 already added PHY for the shell, so no change.

name: Crustle
rationale: Weight 200 kg with def 125 and the Stone Home shell makes a static, unbreakable centre-back; spe 45 rules out the flanks and Layer 1 already rewarded its bulk.

name: Scraggy
rationale: Its kick-heavy move list including high-jump-kick and head-smash already lifted SHO, TEC and KIC in Layer 1; at height 0.6 m and spe 48 it remains a scrappy, combative player with no further change.

name: Scrafty
rationale: Def and spd 115 with ability Intimidate make a tough, combative defender, but genus Hoodlum points to an enforcer rather than a keeper, so HAN trims; spe 58 keeps it central.

name: Sigilyph
rationale: Spa 103 and spe 97 with wings shape give a light, mobile creator who floats over play; weight 14 kg and atk 58 offer no physical edge, matching the baseline.

name: Yamask
rationale: Def 85 is its only real asset on a 1.5 kg ghost body with spe 30; the arms shape already raised HAN, so it is a fringe defensive option with no change.

name: Cofagrigus
rationale: Def 145 and a 1.7 m coffin body make a natural goal-blocker, and its design's four large shadow hands earn back the HAN that the blob shape took away; spe 30 rules out outfield running.

name: Tirtouga
rationale: Def 103 and spe 22 on a 16.5 kg quadruped turtle make a slow, sturdy stopper; abilities Solid Rock and Sturdy fit a block-first role already reflected in the baseline.

name: Carracosta
rationale: Def 133 and atk 108 at weight 81 kg make a rock-solid centre-back, but its limbs are flippers, so the upright-driven TEC and HAN are trimmed; spe 32 keeps it deep.

name: Archen
rationale: Atk 112 on a 9.5 kg winged body gives a sharp, punchy forward; ability Defeatist already cut STA in Layer 1, and def 45 keeps it out of defence, so no change.

name: Archeops
rationale: Atk 140 and spe 110 with wings shape make an explosive aerial attacker; ability Defeatist makes it fade once worn down, which Layer 1 applied to STA, and def 65 keeps it forward.

name: Trubbish
rationale: A 0.6 m trash bag with stubby limbs earns less than the humanoid shape's DRI and HAN bonuses, so both are trimmed; spe 65 and def 62 leave a scrappy full-back, and ability Stench fits an off-putting presence.

name: Garbodor
rationale: Long garbage arms on a height 1.9 m frame suit a blocking centre-back or keeper; a sprawling trash-heap design does not support close control at DRI 67, so it trims slightly.

name: Zorua
rationale: Genus Tricky Fox and ability Illusion define a deceiver, which on a pitch means feints and disguised runs, so DRI rises; def 40 and weight 12.5 kg keep it away from defending.

name: Zoroark
rationale: Spa 120, atk 105 and spe 105 on an agile 81.1 kg upright frame make a creative forward, and ability Illusion fits a deceptive dribbler, so DRI gets a small lift; def 60 makes it fragile.

name: Minccino
rationale: A 5.8 kg quadruped with spe 75 and ACC 80 is a darting wide runner; abilities Technician and Skill Link already nudged TEC and SHO in Layer 1, so no change.

name: Gothita

name: Gothorita
rationale: Spd 85 and spa 75 with spe 55 suit a deliberate central passer; genus Manipulate fits a controlling midfielder, and the baseline needs no change.

name: Gothitelle

name: Reuniclus

name: Ducklett

name: Vanillite

name: Foongus

rationale: Hp 114 and ability Regenerator give a durable, tireless holding mid. Layer 1 already applied KIC -8 for the arms shape, but a 0.6 m mushroom with cap-shaped arms does not merit HAN 85, so it is trimmed.

name: Frillish
rationale: Spd 85 is its best stat on a floating jellyfish body with tentacles shape and spe 40; Layer 1 tentacle mods already handled its lack of feet, so no change.

rationale: Height 2.2 m and weight 135 kg with hp 100 and long tentacles make a large, enveloping presence in front of or in goal; spe 60 rules out running roles, matching the baseline.

rationale: Hp 165 and ability Healer give enormous staying power and a supportive identity, but fish shape removes legs, which Layer 1 already penalized; it is a static blocker at the back.

name: Joltik
rationale: Height 0.1 m and weight 0.6 kg make the shortest body in the generation, which already keeps PHY low, and spe 65 is its only real asset, so no change.

name: Galvantula
rationale: Spe 108 and spa 97 on a light 14.3 kg spider body suit a quick, creative wide player; ability Compound Eyes already lifted VIS in Layer 1, so no change.

name: Ferroseed

rationale: Def 131 and spd 116 at weight 110 kg with spe 20 make a spiked, immovable centre-back; ability Iron Barbs makes every challenge costly, and the baseline already reflects its slowness.

name: Eelektrik
rationale: Fish shape and ability Levitate leave an eel that floats without legs, so Layer 1 pace and ball-skill cuts stand; atk 85 and def 70 still make it a usable central blocker.

name: Eelektross
rationale: Atk 115 and spa 105 on a 2.1 m, 80.5 kg eel make a big central presence; it has clawed arms that the fish shape ignores, so some HAN returns, but no legs keeps pace and footwork low.

name: Elgyem
rationale: Spa 85 and abilities Telepathy and Analytic suit a small cerebral playmaker; spe 30 and weight 9 kg give no running or physical game, as the baseline already shows.

name: Beheeyem
rationale: Spa 125 and spd 95 with ability Telepathy make an elite deep-lying passer; spe 40 means it dictates from the middle rather than running, which the baseline already shows.

name: Litwick
rationale: Height 0.3 m candle body with blob shape and spe 20 has no legs to play on; Layer 1 already cut it heavily, so no further change.

name: Lampent
rationale: Spa 95 on a floating 13 kg lamp with spe 55 supports some creative passing; its small arms already earned the Layer 1 HAN bonus, and nothing else needs correcting.

name: Chandelure
rationale: Spa 145 gives elite vision and passing range, and its floating chandelier body with spread arms suits covering goal, but with no legs KIC stays low; the baseline already balances these.

name: Axew
rationale: Atk 87 on a small 0.6 m upright dragon with tusks gives a punchy young forward; spe 57 and hp 46 limit it, and the baseline already ranks ST and W first.

name: Fraxure
rationale: Atk 117 with spe 67 on an upright 36 kg frame makes a direct forward who can also win the ball; ability Mold Breaker and genus Axe Jaw fit an aggressive style already captured.

name: Haxorus

name: Cubchoo
rationale: Atk 70 with low-kick and mega-kick in kickMoves gives a sturdy little forward, but spe 40 and height 0.5 m keep it slow and light; the baseline already reflects this.

name: Beartic
rationale: Height 2.6 m and weight 260 kg with atk 130 make a giant enforcer at the back; spe 50 limits mobility, and the quadruped mods already lowered ball skills, so no change.

name: Cryogonal
rationale: Spe 105 and spd 135 on a floating snowflake with ball shape give quick reactions and coverage but no limbs to strike with; Layer 1 already cut ball skills, so no change.

name: Shelmet
rationale: Def 85 and spe 25 in a 7.7 kg snail shell make a slow, armoured blocker; ball shape mods already strip its ball skills, so no change.

name: Accelgor
rationale: Spe 145 is the highest in the generation, and ability Unburden plus its ninja design fit a blistering winger; the arms-shape PAC cut in Layer 1 undersells that, so PAC rises.

name: Stunfisk
rationale: Hp 109 and def 84 on a flat 11 kg fish with spe 32 make a trap-setter that lies in wait; genus Trap fits positional defending, and Layer 1's fish mods already remove its mobility.

name: Mienfoo
rationale: Genus Martial Arts and kickMoves high-jump-kick, jump-kick and low-sweep already gave large Layer 1 kick bonuses; atk 85 and spe 65 on a light 20 kg frame leave a nimble young striker, so no change.

name: Mienshao
rationale: Atk 125 and spe 105 with an 11-move kickMoves list, tied for the generation's longest and running from high-jump-kick to triple-axel, make a complete striker; Layer 1 already maxed its kicking, and def 60 marks it as fragile.

name: Druddigon
rationale: Atk 120 and def 90 at weight 139 kg make a heavy, physical stopper; spe 48 limits mobility and ability Rough Skin punishes contact, all consistent with the baseline.

name: Golett
rationale: Weight 92 kg at height 1.0 m with spe 35 makes a heavy, clumsy automaton; the humanoid and kickMoves bonuses from Layer 1 are already enough, so no change.

name: Golurk
rationale: Height 2.8 m and weight 330 kg with atk 124 make a towering presence, dominant in the air at both ends; spe 55 and ACC 34 keep it central, and the baseline already says so.

name: Pawniard
rationale: Atk 85 and spe 60 on a 10.2 kg body suit a sharp, aggressive forward; genus Sharp Blade and its bladed hands do not support the Layer 1 HAN bonus, so it trims.

name: Bisharp
rationale: Atk 125 and def 100 make a hard-tackling centre-back or forward, but genus Sword Blade means blades for hands, so the HAN and DIV bonuses from Layer 1 are cut; spe 70 with ACC 56 is not quick off the mark.

name: Bouffalant
rationale: Genus Bash Buffalo and kickMoves headbutt and skull-bash describe a head-first charger, so AER edges up; hp 95 and atk 110 on 94.6 kg suit a tireless, physical centre-back.

name: Rufflet
rationale: Atk 83 on a 10.5 kg eaglet with wings shape and abilities Sheer Force and Hustle makes a brave, combative young forward; Layer 1 wing mods already apply.

name: Braviary
rationale: Atk 123 and hp 100 with wings at height 1.5 m make a commanding aerial player at either end; genus Valiant and ability Defiant fit an aggressive, brave style the baseline already captures.

name: Vullaby

name: Mandibuzz
rationale: Hp 110 and def 105 with wings shape make a durable aerial defender who can sweep the area or cover goal; atk 65 and spa 55 offer little going forward, matching the baseline.

name: Heatmor
rationale: Atk 97 and spa 105 on an upright 58 kg body give real range; spe 65 already tempers TEC, so no change, and abilities Gluttony and Flash Fire have no football bearing.

name: Durant

name: Deino
rationale: Genus Irate and ability Hustle give a reckless, head-first forward, and its design has fur covering its eyes, so VIS drops; atk 65 and spe 38 keep it modest overall.

name: Zweilous
rationale: Two heads on a 50 kg quadruped body with atk 85 and genus Hostile make a brawling, head-first player; its covered eyes cost VIS, while two heads help it in the air.

name: Hydreigon
rationale: Spa 125 and atk 105 with ability Levitate make a dominant flying attacker, but its arms end in heads, so HAN drops; genus Brutal fits an aggressive, physical game.

name: Larvesta
rationale: Atk 85 on a 28.8 kg armor-shaped larva with spe 60 gives a blunt, middling player; its horned head helps it bump and head, but nothing in its fields calls for a change.

name: Volcarona
rationale: Spa 135 and spe 100 with bug-wings shape give a soaring creator who sees the whole pitch; atk 60 and weight 46 kg offer no tackling bite, and the baseline already favours creative roles.

name: Cobalion
rationale: Def 129 and spe 108 at weight 250 kg make a fast, unbreakable centre-back, and genus Iron Will with ability Justified fit a disciplined leader; the quadruped shape already cuts HAN in Layer 1, so no change.

name: Virizion
rationale: Spd 129 and spe 108 make a resilient, graceful runner suited to covering a flank or the middle; the quadruped shape already cuts HAN in Layer 1, so no change.

name: Tornadus

name: Thundurus

name: Reshiram

name: Zekrom
rationale: Atk 150 at height 2.9 m and weight 345 kg gives overwhelming power in the box at either end; ACC 67 limits sharp movement and the baseline already reflects its bulk.

name: Landorus

name: Kyurem

name: Keldeo

name: Meloetta

name: Genesect

name: Chespin

name: Quilladin

name: Chesnaught
rationale: Def 122, weight 900 and the shield move spiky-shield in kickMoves make it a wall at the back; spe 64 and baseline ACC 50 keep it central.

name: Fennekin
rationale: Spa 62 and spe 60 on a quadruped fox at height 4 give quick, light movement; def 40 and shape quadruped already show in low TAK and HAN.

name: Braixen

name: Delphox
rationale: Spa 114, spe 104 and the psychic type make it a playmaker who directs play from range; the baseline already reflects atk 69, so no change.

name: Froakie
